newsitem.title: USA: Southern Community sets initial dividend.
newsitem.headline: Southern Community sets initial dividend.

text.p: Southern Community Bancshares Inc said on Friday that it has set an initial quarterly dividend of $0.075 per share.
The dividend is payable to all shareholders of record as of March 31, 1997, the company said.

Southern Community is the holding company for First Federal Savings and Loan Association of Cullman. The company converted into a federal stock savings association from a mutually chartered savings and loan on December 23, 1996.
